title: The Second-Derivative Test: A Discriminant Decides
topic: Classifying a critical point with the Hesse matrix. At a stationary point the first-order term vanishes, so the second-order term decides the shape: bowl, dome, or saddle. The discriminant D = f_xx · f_yy − f_xy² and the sign of f_xx read the verdict off the Hesse matrix.

beats.narration: When the gradient vanishes, the first order story is over. The Hesse matrix takes over and decides the shape.

elements.content: Manimo bobs centre, caption 'Three shapes, three verdicts.'

beats.narration: First case. Both eigenvalues of the Hesse matrix are positive — equivalently, the discriminant is positive and f sub x x is positive. The point sits at the bottom of a bowl. A local minimum.

elements.content: Concentric closed elliptical contours around origin, chalk-300, drawn left of centre
Right panel: 'local minimum' eyebrow (emerald-400) + Hesse matrix with f_xx, f_xy, f_xy, f_yy + 'D > 0, f_xx > 0' footnote

beats.narration: Flip the signs. Both eigenvalues negative, discriminant still positive but f sub x x is negative. Now the contours close around a hilltop — a local maximum.

elements.content: Same elliptical contours, this time with hottest level at centre (drawn rose-400 with subtle warmth gradient)
Right panel: 'local maximum' eyebrow (rose-400) + Hesse matrix with negative diagonal + 'D > 0, f_xx < 0' footnote

beats.narration: Now mix the signs. Eigenvalues have opposite signs, so the discriminant is negative. The contours cross through the point — it's a saddle.

elements.content: Hyperbolic contours through origin — both axes meet at the saddle, drawn amber-400 with chalk-300 hyperbolae
Right panel: 'saddle point' eyebrow (amber-400) + Hesse matrix with mixed signs + 'D < 0' footnote

beats.narration: Two numbers read the geometry. The discriminant tells you closed or crossed; the diagonal tells you up or down.

elements.content: 'Two numbers, three verdicts.' — serif italic 54px, 'three verdicts' in amber-300
'D = f_xx f_yy − f_xy²; sign of D, sign of f_xx — done.' — serif italic 24px
